text:
Noah: Heads-up: landing Kyoto Station at 09:40 on Tuesday. Looking for quick ramen near the station or a cozy izakaya for a late lunch. Prefer something not touristy and open by 10:30. Any recs?
Eri: Try Menya Ino on Shichijo-dori, opens 10:00 and usually quiet after morning rush. Tonkotsu but they have a shoyu option.
Leo: If you want auberge vibe, Torito Izakaya is small and opens 11:30 but great oden and vegetarian sides. Not walk-in-friendly for big groups.
hana-ops: For pure speed, Ramen Street in the station has a few stalls, opens 10:00, very reliable. Not the coziest but fast.
Noah: Good notes. Packing light so will head straight there. Anyone prefer ramen or izakaya? React with :ramen: for ramen, :sake: for izakaya.
Eri: :ramen:
Leo: :sake: (leaning izakaya for ambiance)
hana-ops: :ramen: (tight schedule)
Noah: Poll shows ramen wins. Ill try Menya Ino first; if crowd is bad, fallback to station stalls. Thanks!
travel-bot: Reminder set: arrival Kyoto 09:40. Estimated to Ramen Street by 10:10 depending on luggage.
